scope: Offline research only; ancestors immutable; production, Pi, timers, dashboard, account and orders forbidden. B/C archived, never mutated.
sealed: No 2026 observations opened. Earlier 2022-2025 research means historical OOS is not newly pristine. All new mutations see only 2020-2021. No rolling reuse of validation/OOS for design.

universe.rule: Single identity-aware historical spot archive census of all 568 archived risky USDT symbols, including ceased symbols. Top FIVE TOTAL by trailing30 actual quote volume among >=365 observed-day identities, not BTC/ETH plus five. Standalone BTC/ETH still require warmup and liquidity but not top5 rank. Portfolio families use top5 only. Missing slots remain cash. Known spot notices publication-aware. Perp admission additionally requires own actual perp bars/history; spot returns never enter perp accounting. Ranking is liquidity, never relative past return in F/G/H.

tracks.F_G_H: BINANCE_SPOT_RESEARCH_PROXY: actual spot OHLCV; fees/lot history not venue-certified. Not Hyperliquid PnL.
tracks.D: BINANCE_USDM_CONSERVATIVE_PROXY: actual perp trade/mark/funding only; same historical underlying PIT census mapped only to exact same-ticker available perp contract. Historical maintenance/fee/lot certification absent. Never venue-certified or Hyperliquid historical performance.
tracks.hyperliquid: Current public rules evidenced separately. $10 order floor from HL own error docs, 4.5bps taker and szDecimals from meta. No account API. These do not certify Binance historical performance. D uses more adverse fees and explicit quantity precision uncertainty. HL history cannot cover 2020-2022.

execution.precision_note: Explicit fractional research proxy, not historical certified lot sizes. Coarse quantity stress rounds to $1 reference-price lots at submission. No Binance floor attributed to HL; HL $10 independently evidenced. No undocumented reduce-only waiver assumed.
execution.residual: No forced flat fold closes. Dust and TTL residual remain held, marked, and retry only on next scheduled decision or new regime loss. End NAV includes open positions, open/closed episodes separate. Never invent an exit. Missing held mark retains last actual valuation flagged stale, never treats absence as tradable zero return. Missing held mark >24h or unexecutable exit >72h above 10%NAV invalidates reliability, not the saved diagnostic curve. Dust itself never invalidates a replay.
execution.fills: Daily completed signal available next midnight+60sec => earliest04:00 actual 4h open. Previous fully published bar i-2 quote participation. Fixed signed target quantity, reductions before additions, cash/margin constrained, TTL cancels order not position. Regime loss daily may request exit but cadence gates entries/reweights. Portfolio quantity persists across annual OOS folds. Gross limit monitored each executable bar and reduced causally; no close-price fill.
execution.valuation: Spot cash+own quantities. Perp cash collateral plus own mark movement, signed long/short separately; funding actual timestamp debits use mark available at event (previous closed mark plus current open only at boundary), never later close. Mark gap proxy uses same PERP trade price with adverse uncertainty scenario, explicitly flagged. No spot-price substitute.

signals: Long above SMA*(1+h), off below SMA*(1-h); signed D short uses symmetric opposite threshold. Dual requires close>slow AND fast>slow, symmetric negative. Breakout enters beyond PRIOR n-day HIGH and exits beyond PRIOR n-day LOW, symmetric hysteresis expands both bands; signed opposite for shorts. Momentum close/close.shift(n)-1 beyond +/-h. Combo SMA200 AND mom180, or breakout55 AND mom180; opposing evidence exits to cash. Confirmation n means n consecutive completed days (0 is immediate). State persists inside symmetric band. Weekly Sunday and month-end decisions; confirmed regime loss exits on first causal bar, no daily winner rotation.

families.F: BTC/ETH single or equal slots among five liquidity-ranked eligible assets, each own signal; no return ranking. Fixed isolated rules and prespecified combinations.
families.G: BTC core weight1-satellite; satellite cap25/50/75%, 1/2 liquidity-ranked alts, own positive trend, BTC positive required. Missing satellite goes cash, not enlarged core. BTC regime loss closes all at first executable bar. Core uses same chosen slow signal.
families.H: Top2/3/5 liquidity universe slots, each own trend. Equal risk uses trailing60 covariance shrinkage50% diagonal and iterative equal-risk contributions; inverse-vol separate. Compute slot weights BEFORE signal mask; missing/negative members remain CASH, never redistribute negative slots.
families.D: BTC long/cash/short; diversified own-trend signed; beta-neutral positive-trend long and negative-trend short with trailing180 BTC betas clipped0.25..3; funding-aware own-trend signed skips positions with trailing7-day sign-adjusted annual funding debit>20%. Gross1/1.25, no relative-return B mutation. All use own perp signals/returns and historical funding.

D_risk.liquidation: Adverse simultaneous intrabar lows for longs/highs for shorts incl extra mark uncertainty. NAV <= maintenance or NAV/maintenance<3 invalidates proxy safety and orders flat at next real open; never claim protective same-bar stop or invented fill. Continue diagnostic ledger where solvent; bankruptcy explicit reject. All scenarios must remain remote from liquidation for any proxy qualification.
D_risk.funding: Actual timestamped rates; doubled DEBITS only, credits unchanged; extra adverse scenario removes credits and adds10%pa gross charge. Missing events/mark intervals enumerated; no claim full historical margin brackets.

evolution.rule: Same seeds per arm, three mutation rounds. Development metrics only. Six Pareto survivors via nondominated ranks then crowding, lexical tie. No weighted fitness. Fixed factorial panel evaluated separately; may enter validation but does not feed mutation population. Validation nominees = six final survivors per arm plus fixed panel; freeze before opening validation. Validation chooses robust MDD<=25%, aggressive, compromise by Pareto then specified lexicographic rules before OOS.

selection.baseline_qualified: Development AND validation positive CAGR, MDD<=35%, reliable execution; validation benchmark noninferiority. No stop/TP tested otherwise.
selection.benchmark_gate: Meaningful gain CAGR+5pp OR MDD-5pp OR Sharpe+0.15 OR Calmar+0.25 OR asset positive-profit share-0.15 OR one profitable fold. No deterioration CAGR<-10pp, MDD>+5pp, Sharpe<-0.20, Calmar<-0.30 vs matched BTC_SMA200. Compare same venue track/time/capital/costs.
selection.slots: Per family+arm: aggressive max validation CAGR among qualified Pareto; robust min validation MDD among qualified withMDD<=25%, then maxCalmar; compromise max validationCalmar among qualified Pareto. If none, same rules on reliable Pareto diagnostic REJECT, never qualified. Fixed panel OOS fully reported without feedback to finalists.
selection.pass: Reliability; validation qualification; OOS benchmark gate; CAGR>=150%, DD<=35%, Sharpe>=1.5, Calmar>=4; positive >=2/3 OOS folds; 2xcost/delay/no-best-day/no-top3 all CAGR>0 andDD<=35%; >=75% neighbors positive withDD<=35%; no margin proximity. Lower-risk/Pareto alternatives are reported but not relabeled target PASS.

overlays.eligibility: Only baseline_qualified development+validation candidates, frozen before OOS
overlays.rule: Signals generated from completed daily own close only; stop20% from actual entry fill, trailing25% from completed daily highs, partialTP closes half after50% gain; next executable bar, no intrabar fictitious fill; stopped positions may reenter only next scheduled positive regime transition. Overlay panel not evolved and all ablations reported. No leverage overlay in F/G/H.

annual OOS folds with positions carried

deepseek.input: Only development metrics and allowed JSON enums; never validation/OOS/forward, no tools/code/evaluator changes; strict exactly4 JSON candidates; invalid/duplicate reasons logged; API unavailable=>deterministic fallback disclosed.

benchmark: BTC_SMA200 daily own close>SMA200 elseCASH, same ledger, PIT eligibility, minimum/fees/slippage/funding and periods. Both spot and true perp benchmarks recomputed. Also2022-2025 contextual continuous replay, not old stored30%CAGR input.
metrics: Actual dollar NAV, elapsed365.25 CAGR, daily sample Sharpe, simultaneous adverse intrabar MDD, Calmar uses positive loss magnitude. Annual folds slice continuous OOS; costs fee/slippage/funding debit/credit separately. Closed episode is uninterrupted signed position from zero until actual flat; scale changes not new episode. Removal excludes whole episode account log contributions incl fees/funding, no dropping three best fills. Open positions separately valued, not silently closed. No-old-PnL audit required.
